wish: someone should make a game that teaches piano playing
spec:
A note appears on a treble or bass staff; you press the matching key on a one-octave piano and hear it.
Pick treble, bass or both; wrong keys play their own note and two misses mark the right key; score, streak and best streak are kept.
Naturals only (white keys); it does not listen to a real piano or teach rhythm.
notes: Every session opens on middle C, then random notes in range (treble C4-A5, bass E2-C4). Sound is synthesized with Web Audio; computer keys A-G also work.
